description: NOTE_NUM is listed in the spec's ENV CONTRACT table (line 21) as the 'note internal article id', but it is wired ONLY in stage2 (note-stage2-publish.py:10) and rebuild-note-body.py:15. There is no NOTE_NUM consumer in stage1, which is acceptable, but there is no mechanism by which a non-Automaton run obtains a DIFFERENT note id: every active entrypoint (publish-to-note.sh, run-note-agent.sh) only passes --key (the slug), never NOTE_NUM. For a brand-new article the slug 'new' path (publish-to-note.sh:43-48) renders+drafts but stage2 still uploads images against NUM=166686292 (the Automaton numeric id) because NOTE_NUM is never overridden. upload_body_image(sess, p, NUM) at stage2:32/37/43 would therefore attach a non-Automaton article's images to the Automaton note's image bucket. The env var exists but is not plumbed through the orchestrator for the 'new article' case, so a real non-Automaton run cannot avoid the 166686292 leak.
correctFix: Plumb NOTE_NUM (and the rest of the contract: NOTE_SRC, NOTE_INFOG, NOTE_TAGS, NOTE_IMG_DIR) from publish-to-note.sh into the stage1/stage2 environment for the chosen article, and for --key new resolve the freshly-created note id BEFORE stage2 uploads (the TODO at publish-to-note.sh:47 is unimplemented).
